entries.title: Update 1.1.0
entries.text:
- Fixed an issue when at full health, the player took red heart damage instead of spirit hearts, where viable.
- Fixed bug where banana only granted player the heart upgrade on the floor after it had been picked up.
- Fixed the item 'Guilt Soaked Ledger' where the UI clipped on wider screens.
- Changed the damage SFX for the player, as consensus was that the original sound was annoying and off-putting.
- Fixed bug where if the player clipped into a certain wall in the Craig Floor, they would be set to one health, have all items stripped from them and be transported to the 'Nightmare Zone'.
- Located and removed 'Nightmare Zone'.

entries.title: Initial Release
entries.text: - Fully playable version of Momentum Bound!
